seed_fact: No search bar on content-heavy sites frustrates users. Add one if you have 20+ pages.
image_headline: Customers can’t find what they need
caption:
Can't find what they need on your site? If your site has more than 20 pages and lacks a search bar, visitors get frustrated and leave. Adding a simple search makes it easy for customers to find exactly what they need. DM me for a quick site audit.
